gloss: division into two; splitting in half

definitions.gloss: division into two; splitting into two parts
definitions.explanation: Dividing something into two parts, or two sides splitting something evenly between them. Often used of opinion, votes, or territory: {世論|よろん}を{二分|にぶん}する (to split public opinion in two).

definitions.gloss: one half (in the fraction {二分|にぶん}の{一|いち})
definitions.explanation: In arithmetic, {二分|にぶん}の{一|いち} is the fraction one half. The pattern is 'denominator + {分|ぶん}の + numerator', so {三分|さんぶん}の{二|に} is two thirds.

examples.japanese: {世論|よろん}を{二分|にぶん}する{問題|もんだい}だ。
examples.english: It is an issue that splits public opinion in two.

examples.japanese: {土地|とち}を{兄弟|きょうだい}で{二分|にぶん}した。
examples.english: The brothers divided the land between them.

examples.japanese: {天下|てんか}を{二分|にぶん}する{戦|たたか}いが{百年|ひゃくねん}{近|ちか}く{続|つづ}いた。
examples.english: A struggle that split the country in two continued for nearly a hundred years.

examples.japanese: {全体|ぜんたい}の{二分|にぶん}の{一|いち}だ。
examples.english: It is one half of the whole.

examples.japanese: {砂糖|さとう}を{二分|にぶん}の{一|いち}に{減|へ}らした。
examples.english: I reduced the sugar to one half.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}の{人口|じんこう}は{三十年|さんじゅうねん}{前|まえ}の{二分|にぶん}の{一|いち}にまで{減|へ}ってしまった。
examples.english: The population of this town has fallen to half of what it was thirty years ago.

notes:
{二|に} (two) + {分|ぶん} (part, division). As a suru-verb it is transitive: 〜を{二分|にぶん}する.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世論|よろん}を{二分|にぶん}する: to split public opinion
- {意見|いけん}が{二分|にぶん}される: opinion is divided in two
- {人気|にんき}を{二分|にぶん}する: to share the spotlight (of two rivals)
- {二分|にぶん}の{一|いち}: one half

READING CAUTION:
The same characters read にふん mean 'two minutes.' The division sense is always にぶん, so the reading tells you which is meant: {二分|にふん}{待|ま}つ (wait two minutes) versus {二分|にぶん}する (divide in two).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {半分|はんぶん}: half — the everyday noun for the resulting portion, not the act of dividing
- {分割|ぶんかつ}する: to divide up — into any number of parts, not specifically two
